section.32: The Book of Jihad and Expeditions

32.name_native: The Book of Jihad and Expeditions

hadiths.text: The tradition has been narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik (the same narrator) through a different chain of transmitters, but this version does not mention:" And he was not the Negus for whom the Prophet (ﷺ) had said the funeral prayers
